items.fullSentence: Je vais au cinéma ce soir.
items.sentenceTrans: I'm going to the cinema tonight.

whyWrong.vas: vas is the tu form — with je it's vais.
whyWrong.va: va is the il/elle form — with je it's vais.
whyWrong.allons: allons is the nous form — with je it's vais.

items.sentenceTrans: We're going to the restaurant on Saturday.

whyWrong.vont: vont is the ils/elles form — with nous it's allons.
whyWrong.allez: allez is the vous form — with nous it's allons.
whyWrong.va: va is singular — nous takes allons.

whyWrong.à le: à + le contracts to au — au cinéma, never 'à le'.
whyWrong.à la: cinéma is masculine — à + le = au, not à la.
whyWrong.à: à alone isn't enough with cinéma — you need the article: au.

items.fullSentence: Léa va à la piscine le mardi.
items.sentenceTrans: Léa goes to the pool on Tuesdays.

whyWrong.au: piscine is feminine — à la piscine, not au.
whyWrong.à le: 'à le' isn't valid, and piscine is feminine anyway — à la.
whyWrong.à: à alone isn't enough — feminine piscine takes à la.

items.sentenceTrans: The patient is going to the hospital.

whyWrong.au: hôpital starts with a vowel sound — à l', not au.
whyWrong.à la: hôpital starts with a vowel sound — à l', not à la.
whyWrong.à le: 'à le' isn't valid, and before a vowel it becomes à l'.

items.fullSentence: Je vais aux toilettes, je reviens.
items.sentenceTrans: I'm going to the toilet, I'll be back.

whyWrong.au: toilettes is plural — à + les = aux, not au.
whyWrong.à les: à + les contracts to aux — never 'à les'.
whyWrong.à la: toilettes is plural — use aux, not à la.

items.fullSentence: L'année prochaine, je vais à Paris.
items.sentenceTrans: Next year, I'm going to Paris.

whyWrong.au: Cities take plain à — à Paris, not au.
whyWrong.à la: Cities take plain à — à Paris, not à la.
whyWrong.en: en is for feminine countries — cities take à: à Paris.

whyWrong.va: va is the il/elle form — tu vas.
whyWrong.vais: vais is the je form — tu vas.
whyWrong.allez: allez is the vous form — tu vas.

items.fullSentence: Mes amis vont au concert ce soir.
items.sentenceTrans: My friends are going to the concert tonight.

whyWrong.va: Mes amis is plural — ils vont.
whyWrong.allons: allons is the nous form — ils vont.
whyWrong.allez: allez is the vous form — ils vont.
